chapter.v:
When Israel
went forth out of Egypt,The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

Judah became
his sanctuary,Israel his dominion.

The sea
saw it, and fled;The Jordan was driven back.

The mountains
skipped like rams,The little hills like lambs.

What aileth
thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest?Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?

Ye mountains,
that ye skip like rams;Ye little hills, like lambs?

Tremble, thou
earth, at the presence of the Lord,At the presence of the God of Jacob,

Who turned
the rock into a pool of water,The flint into a fountain of waters.
